title: Racist Drunk Thinks It’s Ok To Harass His Neighbours
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On May 2nd, 2022. Officers responded to a dispute between 3 men in an apartment complex. The arrestee was said to be extremely drunk, belligerent and swearing at people and started to become violent causing a tenant to step in. After the man was detained, he started yelling out racial slurs and called officers "racists". This is footage of the events that followed.
